# Sellpy Todo Lists

> A todo list application where every edit becomes a datom in an append-only log, persisted on the server and converged across browser tabs in real time.

There is no save button. Text settles, one datom is minted per settled edit, and the server
journals it to an append-only JSONL file before streaming it to every connected client over
Server-Sent Events. Clients fold the log by last-write-wins, so there is no conflict path and no
merge step. Deleting a Todo List takes its title away rather than tombstoning it, which is why
giving the title back brings its Todos with it.
